build_roi_heads: build ROIHeads from config by calling build_roi_heads with cfg and input_shape arguments
select_foreground_proposals: select foreground proposals from a list of Instances by filtering out background and ignored labels
select_proposals_with_visible_keypoints: select proposals that contain at least one visible keypoint inside the proposal bounding box
create_StandardROIHeads: create a StandardROIHeads instance using from_config to initialize box, mask, and keypoint heads independently
create_Res5ROIHeads: create a Res5ROIHeads instance using from_config to build a C4-style R-CNN with shared Res5 block
